📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

Bấm vào nút 🔊 để nghe phát âm chuẩn bản xứ của từng từ vựng (trên iPhone, hãy gạt cần rung sang chế độ Chuông để bật loa ngoài). Hệ thống tối ưu hiển thị linh hoạt trên cả điện thoại, máy tính bảng và máy tính:

⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. innovation (n)
/ˌɪnəˈveɪʃn/
sự đổi mới sáng tạo, phát minh mới
Collocation: technological innovation, drive innovation
"Technological innovation has completely changed how people work and study."
2. artificial (adj)
/ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃl/
nhân tạo (Artificial Intelligence - AI)
Collocation: artificial intelligence, artificial light
"Artificial intelligence can analyze medical images faster than human doctors."
3. automate (v)
/ˈɔːtəmeɪt/
tự động hóa (bằng máy móc/phần mềm)
Collocation: automate routine tasks, fully automated factory
"Modern factories use smart robots to automate repetitive assembly tasks."
4. device (n)
/dɪˈvaɪs/
thiết bị điện tử (điện thoại, máy tính bảng)
Collocation: digital device, portable mobile device
"Students can access online dictionaries on any portable mobile device."
5. virtual (adj)
/ˈvɜːtʃuəl/
ảo, trực tuyến qua không gian mạng
Collocation: virtual classroom, virtual reality (VR)
"During the winter storm, our professor held a virtual lecture on Zoom."
6. accessible (adj)
/əkˈsesəbl/
dễ tiếp cận, có thể truy cập được
Collocation: easily accessible, accessible to everyone
"High-speed internet makes world-class education accessible to rural students."
7. efficiency (n)
/ɪˈfɪʃnsi/
hiệu suất, sự hiệu quả tối ưu
Collocation: improve efficiency, energy efficiency
"Cloud software helps businesses improve their daily operational efficiency."
8. cybersecurity (n)
/ˈsaɪbəsɪkjʊərəti/
an ninh mạng, bảo mật thông tin số
Collocation: strengthen cybersecurity, cybersecurity threat
"Banks invest heavily in cybersecurity to protect customer accounts from hackers."
9. privacy (n)
/ˈprɪvəsi/
quyền riêng tư, sự bảo mật cá nhân
Collocation: data privacy, protect personal privacy
"Social media users should adjust their settings to protect personal privacy."
10. addiction (n)
/əˈdɪkʃn/
sự nghiện, sự lệ thuộc quá mức
Collocation: smartphone addiction, overcome screen addiction
"Excessive gaming can lead to severe screen addiction among teenagers."
11. communicate (v)
/kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/
giao tiếp, liên lạc
Collocation: communicate instantly, communicate with colleagues
"Messaging apps allow families to communicate instantly across continents."
12. platform (n)
/ˈplætfɔːm/
nền tảng số (học tập, mạng xã hội)
Collocation: e-learning platform, social media platform
"Interactive e-learning platforms make language practice much more engaging."
13. transform (v)
/trænsˈfɔːm/
chuyển đổi, làm thay đổi toàn diện
Collocation: transform education, transform the way we live
"Renewable energy and smart grids will transform modern cities."
14. breakthrough (n)
/ˈbreɪkθruː/
bước đột phá (khoa học/công nghệ)
Collocation: scientific breakthrough, major breakthrough
"Scientists achieved a major breakthrough in battery storage technology."
15. productive (adj)
/prəˈdʌktɪv/
năng suất cao, làm việc hiệu quả
Collocation: highly productive, productive study session
"Turning off phone notifications helps me stay productive while writing essays."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Các Thì Tương Lai & Câu Điều Kiện Loại 1)

• Phân biệt Will vs Be going to:
  - will + V-bare: Dự đoán tương lai dựa trên quan điểm (I think, probably, in 2030) hoặc quyết định tức thời.
  Ví dụ: Artificial intelligence will transform healthcare in the next decade.
  - am/is/are going to + V-bare: Kế hoạch đã định trước hoặc dự đoán có căn cứ rõ ràng ở hiện tại.
  Ví dụ: Our school is going to launch a new e-learning platform next month.

• Câu điều kiện loại 1 (First Conditional): Diễn tả sự việc có thật, rất có khả năng xảy ra ở hiện tại hoặc tương lai.
  Công thức: If + S + V (Hiện tại đơn), S + will / can / should + V-bare
  Ví dụ: If students use digital devices wisely, they will become much more productive.

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Từ Nối Tương Phản & Liên Từ Điều Kiện Unless)

• Liên từ điều kiện phủ định Unless (= If ... not):
  Ví dụ: Unless companies strengthen cybersecurity, user data privacy will be at risk.

• Cặp từ nối lập luận 2 chiều cho Task 2 & Speaking Part 3:
  - On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ... (Một mặt thì... Mặt khác thì...)
  - However, / Nevertheless, (Tuy nhiên - luôn đứng đầu câu sau dấu chấm và có dấu phẩy đi kèm).

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. ________ intelligence (AI) can translate languages and summarize long articles in seconds.
2. Modern car factories use smart robots to ________ repetitive manufacturing tasks.
3. High-speed internet has made university lectures easily ________ to students in remote villages.
4. Spending six hours a day scrolling on social media can lead to smartphone ________.
5. Online banking requires strong ________ to protect customers from digital hackers.
6. Users should read terms carefully before sharing personal photos to protect their data ________.
7. Video conferencing apps allow international teams to ________ instantly without traveling.
8. Medical researchers announced a major ________ in early cancer detection using AI.
9. Turning off social media alerts helps workers stay focused and ________ throughout the morning.
10. During the pandemic, millions of students attended ________ classes from home via laptop.
11. Every student in our class uses a portable digital ________ such as a tablet or smartphone.
12. Cloud computing software has greatly improved the operational ________ of small businesses.
13. Continuous technological ________ drives economic growth in the twenty-first century.
14. Coursera and edX are popular online learning ________ that offer university courses.
15. In the coming decades, clean energy and smart software will ________ how we travel.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Learning English online offers a wonderful ________ to connect with global friends.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 2] Students can use digital flashcards to ________ vocabulary before exams.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 3] E-books and digital documents help save paper and halt ________.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 4] Sitting at a computer all day without breaks leads to a ________ lifestyle.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 4] Smartwatches can track heart rate and encourage users to do a daily ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Experts predict that artificial intelligence ________ routine office jobs within the next twenty years.
2. If you ________ your password with strangers, hackers will easily access your private account.
3. Look at the official announcement! Our university ________ a new virtual library platform next Monday.
4. ________ teenagers limit their daily screen time, they will suffer from eye strain and poor sleep.
5. Digital devices make information easily accessible. ________, excessive use can cause screen addiction.
6. If students use e-learning platforms effectively, they ________ their academic performance.
7. Next Saturday at 9 AM, I ________ a cybersecurity workshop with my computer science tutor.
8. On the one hand, automation increases factory efficiency. On the ________ hand, some workers may lose jobs.
9. When high-speed 6G networks ________ available, virtual reality meetings will feel completely natural.
10. I think scientific breakthroughs in renewable energy ________ reduce global carbon emissions soon.
Điểm: 0/10

Luyện nghe chuẩn IELTS Section 1. Có thể tạm dừng (Pause), tua câu thoại hoặc điều chỉnh tốc độ đọc.

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
Coordinator: Good morning, Digital Innovation Hub! How can I help you with our upcoming technology workshops?
Student: Hello! I saw a poster about the weekend workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Study Productivity.
Coordinator: Yes! That is our most popular course this semester. Wait, let me check the schedule. Actually, we moved it from Room 204 to the Virtual Lab. 💡 Bẫy đính chính thông tin câu 1: Virtual Lab
Student: Got it, the Virtual Lab. What practical skills will participants learn during the morning session?
Coordinator: In the morning, you will learn how to use AI tools to automate note-taking and research summaries. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: note-taking / automate note-taking
Student: That will make my essay preparation so much more productive! What about the afternoon session?
Coordinator: The afternoon session focuses on cybersecurity and protecting your personal data privacy online. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: cybersecurity / data privacy
Student: Do I need to bring my own laptop or digital device to the workshop?
Coordinator: Yes, please bring a portable laptop. We will provide free access to the university's cloud platform. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: laptop / portable laptop
Student: Who is the guest speaker leading the workshop this Saturday?
Coordinator: It is Dr. Reynolds. That is spelled R - E - Y - N - O - L - D - S. 💡 Bẫy đánh vần câu 5: REYNOLDS
Student: Is there a registration fee for undergraduate students?
Coordinator: Standard tickets are 15 pounds, but if you register before Wednesday, it is completely free for students! 💡 Đáp án câu 6: Wednesday / free
Student: Awesome! Please sign me up right now.
Coordinator: You are registered! We will send the login link to your university email.
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Rise of Smart Innovation]
Over the past decade, rapid technological innovation has begun to transform almost every aspect of human society. Today, anyone with a portable mobile device can connect to global e-learning platforms and communicate instantly across continents. Because online libraries are easily accessible, students in rural areas now enjoy the same educational opportunities as those in major cities.

[Paragraph B - AI Breakthroughs & Workplace Efficiency]
Recently, a major breakthrough in artificial intelligence (AI) has helped companies automate repetitive clerical tasks. By using smart software and virtual meeting rooms, employees can boost their daily efficiency and become much more productive. Doctors also use AI programs to analyze medical scans with remarkable accuracy.

[Paragraph C - Cybersecurity, Privacy & Screen Addiction]
However, the digital revolution also brings serious challenges. As people store sensitive financial information online, governments and banks must strengthen cybersecurity to protect personal data privacy. Furthermore, psychologists warn that spending too many hours on smartphones can cause digital addiction. Therefore, if society wants to benefit from technology, citizens must learn to use digital tools responsibly.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab: Lợi Ích & Thách Thức Của Công Nghệ Số & AI

Đề bài: Write a short paragraph (50 - 70 words) discussing one advantage and one disadvantage of using smartphones and AI in education.

Tiêu chuẩn: Sử dụng từ nối tương phản (However / On the other hand), câu điều kiện loại 1 (If...) hoặc thì Tương lai (will), và ít nhất 3 từ vựng Unit 5 (innovation, artificial, device, accessible, productive, addiction, privacy, platform...).
